verdict.rationale: Galileo documents first-party programmatic interfaces: a Python SDK (`@log` decorator), Python/TypeScript quickstarts under an "sdk-api" docs section, OTel-based distributed tracing, and an official MCP server for creating datasets, running experiments and managing prompt templates. However, the pack never shows a documented public REST API reference, and probes for an OpenAPI spec returned 404 at every candidate path, so driving the product through a general public API is only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: documented public REST/HTTP API reference, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, evidence that SDK/API coverage extends beyond logging and experiments to full product control (e.g. alerts, metrics config), independent hands-on corroboration.
